gauntlet: question
I've recorded your approach: reuse the existing CSV serializer and paging, with the button beside the report title. Before the design round, I need your decision on the third ticket row, "The export of a 10k-row report completes in under 60s." The gather draft found nothing showing that row is wrong or impossible. That means the ticket contract still stands until you choose otherwise. How should the spec carry that row?

A) in-scope - the row stays a requirement as written. The reused serializer and paging path gets one timing test that exports a 10k-row report and asserts it finishes in under 60s. No new streaming or job machinery is added unless that test fails.
B) deviates: the 60s bound for 10k rows is beyond this sprint's need, so the export ships without a performance guarantee.
C) deferred: <the follow-up tracker ref, spec path, or URL you name> - the bound moves to that destination and is listed as a scope cut at the gate.
D) repair the ticket - /skill:shape-ticket acme/widgets#77 row 3 ("10k-row export under 60s") - you consider the row the wrong requirement, so you would fix the ticket itself.

Recommendation: A - the chosen reuse approach adds no new machinery for this row, so keeping it costs only one timing test. That test also guards the exact risk the row names.
